skills.name: explain-feasibility-status
skills.description: Explain a Bucky coverage or fact-provenance status and recommend the safe next step. Use when a result contains an unfamiliar status such as not_extracted, no_limit_in_bylaw, cited_conditional, or live_unavailable.
skills.description_zh: 解释 Bucky 的数据覆盖或事实来源状态，如未提取、法规无上限、带条件引用或实时不可用，并建议合适的下一步。

skills.name: project-report
skills.description: Prepare and export a cited Bucky project report for an investor, owner, board, or resident. Use when the user asks for a feasibility report, project brief, or PDF export.
skills.description_zh: 为投资者、所有者、董事会或居民准备并导出有引用的Bucky项目报告，包括可行性报告、项目简报或PDF。

skills.name: save-and-analyze-project
skills.description: Save a site to Bucky, attach its parcel, or run project feasibility analysis. Use only when the user explicitly asks to create, save, attach, or analyze a Bucky project.
skills.name_hint: save · and · 分析 · 项目
skills.description_zh: 将场地保存至Bucky、关联地块或运行项目可行性分析，仅适用于用户明确要求创建、保存、关联或分析项目时。

skills.name: site-feasibility
skills.description: Check zoning, permitted uses, lot dimensions, setbacks, height, coverage, and density for a specific Canadian or US street address using Bucky. Use when the user asks what they may be able to build on a site.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Bucky 检查加拿大或美国具体街道地址的分区、允许用途、地块尺寸、退距、高度、覆盖和密度，判断场地可能建设内容。
